Specification: A machine-checked safety and liveness proof for the EWD998 termination detection algorithm using the TLA+ Proof System (TLAPS). It formalizes the inductive invariant (Inv), proves liveness via a series of temporal rounds (Round 1-3), and demonstrates that the algorithm is a correct refinement of a high-level asynchronous termination detection specification.
TheoremNames: TypeCorrect == Init /\ [][Next]_vars => []TypeOK
FoldFunctionIsFoldFunctionOnSet == ASSUME NEW op( *,* ), NEW base, NEW fun PROVE FoldFunction(op, base, fun) = FoldFunctionOnSet(op, base, fun, DOMAIN fun)
FoldFunctionOnSetEmpty == ASSUME NEW op( *,* ), NEW base, NEW fun PROVE FoldFunctionOnSet(op, base, fun, {}) = base

FoldFunctionOnSetIterate == ASSUME NEW op( *,* ), NEW S, IsFiniteSet(S), NEW T, NEW base \in T, NEW fun \in [S -> T], NEW inds \in SUBSET S, NEW e \in inds, IsAssociativeOn(op, T), IsCommutativeOn(op, T), IsIdentityOn(op, base, T) PROVE FoldFunctionOnSet(op, base, fun, inds) = op(fun[e], FoldFunctionOnSet(op, base, fun, inds \ {e}))

FoldFunctionOnSetUnion == ASSUME NEW op( *,* ), NEW S, IsFiniteSet(S), NEW T, NEW base \in T, NEW fun \in [S -> T], NEW inds1 \in SUBSET S, NEW inds2 \in SUBSET S, inds1 \cap inds2 = {}, IsAssociativeOn(op, T), IsCommutativeOn(op, T), IsIdentityOn(op, base, T) PROVE FoldFunctionOnSet(op, base, fun, inds1 \cup inds2) = op(FoldFunctionOnSet(op, base, fun, inds1), FoldFunctionOnSet(op, base, fun, inds2))

FoldFunctionOnSetEqual == ASSUME NEW op( *,* ), NEW S, IsFiniteSet(S), NEW T, NEW base \in T, NEW f \in [S -> T], NEW g \in [S -> T], NEW inds \in SUBSET S, \A x \in inds : f[x] = g[x] PROVE FoldFunctionOnSet(op, base, f, inds) = FoldFunctionOnSet(op, base, g, inds)

FoldFunctionOnSetType == ASSUME NEW op( *,* ), NEW S, NEW T, IsFiniteSet(S), NEW base \in T, NEW fun \in [S -> T], NEW inds \in SUBSET S, \A x,y \in T : op(x,y) \in T PROVE FoldFunctionOnSet(op, base, fun, inds) \in T
NodeIsFinite == IsFiniteSet(Node)
PlusACI == /\ IsAssociativeOn(+, Nat) /\ IsCommutativeOn(+, Nat) /\ IsIdentityOn(+, 0, Nat) /\ IsAssociativeOn(+, Int) /\ IsCommutativeOn(+, Int) /\ IsIdentityOn(+, 0, Int)
SumEmpty == ASSUME NEW fun PROVE Sum(fun, {}) = 0
SumIterate == ASSUME NEW fun \in [Node -> Int], NEW inds \in SUBSET Node, NEW e \in inds PROVE Sum(fun, inds) = fun[e] + Sum(fun, inds \ {e})
SumSingleton == ASSUME NEW fun \in [Node -> Int], NEW x \in Node PROVE Sum(fun, {x}) = fun[x]
SumUnion == ASSUME NEW fun \in [Node -> Int], NEW inds1 \in SUBSET Node, NEW inds2 \in SUBSET Node, inds1 \cap inds2 = {} PROVE Sum(fun, inds1 \cup inds2) = Sum(fun, inds1) + Sum(fun, inds2)
SumEqual == ASSUME NEW f \in [Node -> Int], NEW g \in [Node -> Int], NEW inds \in SUBSET Node, \A x \in inds : f[x] = g[x] PROVE Sum(f, inds) = Sum(g, inds)
SumIsInt == ASSUME NEW fun \in [Node -> Int], NEW inds \in SUBSET Node PROVE Sum(fun, inds) \in Int
SumIsNat == ASSUME NEW fun \in [Node -> Nat], NEW inds \in SUBSET Node PROVE Sum(fun, inds) \in Nat
SumZero == ASSUME NEW fun \in [Node -> Int], NEW inds \in SUBSET Node, \A i \in inds : fun[i] = 0 PROVE Sum(fun, inds) = 0
Invariance == Init /\ [][Next]_vars => []Inv
Safety == /\ TypeOK /\ Inv /\ terminationDetected => Termination /\ TypeOK' /\ Inv' /\ terminationDetected' => Termination'
B0NoMessagePending == /\ TypeOK /\ B=0 => \A i \in Node : pending[i] = 0 /\ TypeOK' /\ B'=0 => \A i \in Node : pending'[i] = 0
EnabledSystem == ASSUME TypeOK, N > 1 / counter=0 PROVE ENABLED <<System>>_vars <=> ...
EnabledAtMaster == ASSUME TypeOK, Inv, Termination, token.pos = 0, ~ terminationDetected PROVE ENABLED <<System>>_vars
Round1 == BSpec => (Termination ~> Termination /\ atMaster)
Round2 == BSpec => (Termination /\ atMaster ~> Termination /\ atMaster /\ allWhite)
Round3 == BSpec => (Termination /\ atMaster /\ allWhite ~> Termination /\ atMaster /\ allWhite /\ tknWhite /\ tknCount)
Detection == TypeOK /\ Inv /\ Termination /\ atMaster /\ allWhite /\ tknWhite /\ tknCount => terminationDetected
Live == []TypeOK /\ []Inv /\ [][Next]_vars /\ WF_vars(System) => Liveness
SpecLive == Spec => Liveness
NodeIsNode == TD!Node = Node
Refinement == Spec => TD!Spec

CASE token.pos = N-1 BY <4>1, <6>1, SumEmpty DEF Rng, Node (in Invariance)
